resources.string: Chat bubble. Tap to open the chat, drag to move it.
Keeps the floating chat bubble available over other apps while it is active.
Tap the bubble to open the chat. A red dot means a new reply is ready.
The chat bubble floats above other apps, so Android needs the "Display over other apps" permission. Tap Open settings, allow it for this app and come back; the bubble will appear automatically.
Could not show the chat bubble. Check that \"Display over other apps\" is allowed.
